verdicts.reason: A breaks up the title lockup: 'Smart Home' floats in the top-right corner, away from 'GADGETS', so it reads as GADGETS → Smart Home. The purple circle has shrunk to a meaningless quarter-wedge sitting on the photo, and GADGETS sits right on the busy robot/floor image. B keeps the purple-circle-and-text lockup together, so the brand and hierarchy survive, but the headline is small for the canvas and the circle has awkward flat cut-offs on its bottom and right. The thin frame and dot grids float arbitrarily over the photo, and both crops make the robot vacuum hard to recognize.
